blueprint.label: v10_processor_mandelbrot
blueprint.description: v10 program: The mandelbrot set over the whole vector: 2451 lanes, 64 wide, 20 iterations of z = z^2 + c in 360ths fixed point, computed by a scalar program that contains no vector instruction at all - every line of it is a write_imm or pulse_imm to a memory row. Seeding costs zero scalar writes: COORD gives each lane its own index and the vec-scal MOD/DIV units turn that into x = i % 64, y = i / 64, then cx = x*DX - OX and cy = y*DY - OY, with the offset applied as an ADDEND on the se
